text:
Lila: Quick note — BankCorp asks for an in-region private upgrade with an HSM key handover and wants total maintenance under 60m. They expect us to run the routing flip. Thoughts?
Noah: Two approaches: (1) Orchestrated switch: we run preflight, drain, swap operator IPs, bind new keys — targeted ~45-60m. (2) Tenant-slice rollout: side-by-side operator, move tenants in waves; longer but per-tenant downtime minimal.
Priya: HSM audit requirement is the wildcard — auditors want signed rotation logs + proof of export. That usually inflates the window unless we pre-provision artifacts.
Sam: Engineering suggestion: pre-provision rotated key material and pre-generate rotation audit bundle in customer's KMS. During maintenance only final binding and a one-line audit signature is needed.
Lila: If Redwood is doing the peering flip we need clear rollback criteria and a support SLA. Can NetOps own the change if customer pays for it?
NetOpsBot: NetOps policy: we'll accept operator-run peering flips for paid engagements if a validated runbook exists and preflight passes. Otherwise customer must perform peering change.
Noah: Product idea: surface an "Orchestrated switch" option in the upgrade flow with a billing tickbox: Redwood-run routing? yes/no. Show upfront uplift and a quick summary of what we will do.
Priya: Legal: we need explicit consent language and a limited-liability clause for network ops we perform. Also require named approver for HSM rotations.
Sam: SRE: implement automated abort triggers: if error-rate rises >4% OR 99p latency increases by >x ms then auto-revert. Also expose a manual revert button in the console during the window.
Lila: Preflight suggestions: IP reservation OK, DNS resolves -> product endpoint, KMS artifacts staged, operator health, model pin confirmed, cache-warm >= 85%, AS-path proof from customer.
NetOpsBot: We'll publish a tiny verifier script customers can run to return AS-path + ACL snapshot. Put link in console.
Priya: For regulated customers require a staging dry-run of HSM rotation and an uploaded audit bundle before permitting the orchestrated switch option.
Noah: Engineering note: for tenant-slice rollouts we need to snapshot routing state and model sequence-lock so rollback is quick per-tenant.
Lila: Action list: Lila write preflight checklist & console copy; Noah spec revert api & thresholds; NetOps publish verifier + runbook; Priya draft legal consent; Sam wire the preflight gating and console block.
Sam: OpsBot: created checklist -> private-upgrade-5078901234. Reminder scheduled tomorrow 08:00 PT to run /preflight 5078901234.
Lila: Let's reconvene Fri 11am PT after a dry run. @Noah @Priya @Sam please ack.
Noah: +1
Priya: +1
Sam: :thumbsup:
